title: PIPES: Securing Agent Perception with Provenance and Priors
abstract: arXiv:2608.12789v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tool-using agents consume external data from sources with different levels of trust, yet tool responses rarely identify who produced each component or what it should convey. We show that this gap enables state-corruption attacks, in which attacker-controlled content makes environmental claims beyond the informational authority of its response component and corrupts the agent's perceived environment, making the resulting action appear justified to existing guardrails. We introduce PIPES (Provenance-Informed, Prior-Enforced Screening), which screens response units using semantic priors and source provenance. PIPES uses static field contracts when schemas provide stable expectations, and conditions screening of open-ended content on the pre-response trajectory and trusted provenance metadata. It marks units that violate their semantic prior or the provenance hierarchy; deployments may remove, warn, block, or escalate detected violations.

translated_title: PIPES：利用来源与先验保障智能体感知安全
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12789v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：使用工具的智能体从不同信任级别的来源消费外部数据，但工具响应很少标识每个组件的生产者或其应传达的内容。我们表明，这一差距使得状态破坏攻击成为可能，攻击者控制的内容会使环境声明超出其响应组件的信息权威范围，从而破坏智能体感知的环境，使后续行动在现有防护措施看来显得合理。我们引入了PIPES（来源知情、先验强制的筛选），它利用语义先验和来源来源对响应单元进行筛选。PIPES在模式提供稳定期望时使用静态字段契约，并根据响应前轨迹和可信来源元数据对开放内容进行条件化筛选。它标记违反语义先验或来源层次结构的单元；部署方可以移除、警告、阻止或升级检测到的违规行为。
tldr: PIPES通过结合来源信息和语义先验，有效识别并防御智能体感知中的状态破坏攻击，确保行动决策的可靠性与安全性。
en_tdlr: PIPES leverages provenance and semantic priors to detect and mitigate state-corruption attacks, securing agent perception and ensuring reliable decision-making.
